chapter_title: The Chapter of the Elements that wept
spiritual_reading:
A sufficient complement of operative powers invested with external truths passed through a full process of grief in the natural degree three times, and then came into restraint and waiting. Yet there remains a final grief at the consummation, after which their lamentation in the natural degree ceases, because their work in that degree is finished and no further state of such distress can return.

The first grief arose when those external truths first perceived the presence of active falsity, and saw that it was about to break forth against their domain. From that perception they comprehended the whole sequence of what would befall them. They recognized the evil that would be raised up to assault them, and yet by the necessity of order they were brought into direct engagement with it and contended against it. They prevailed over it and held it in restraint. They fixed it in the ultimate degree through the very forms and powers by which they act there, and so they subdued the intention of spiritual death, the ardor of self-love, and the obscurity of falsity that accompanied it.

The second grief arose when the first good that had been set for combat was raised out of the ultimate obscurity and withdrawn upward, and those external truths were left in the lower degree; this was the state in which their outward investment was removed and they were left to remain in what is beneath. When they perceived that the leading good had been elevated from the ultimate falsity and had left them behind, and that they were abandoned amid hostility, they fell into grief and interior pain. Yet they could do nothing but endure, because their willing was turned toward every permitted suffering for the sake of the whole work. Therefore they remained behind and languished under the pressure of the heavy burden of all the effects and labors required in the lowest degree, even until the final time.

The third grief arose when the operation of Divine truth from the Divine removed the full series of outward powers of action, and arranged them beneath all things in the ultimate plane for service there. It gave them an assurance and an urging of influx to elevate their understanding and to be raised into higher states from that low condition, and to progress through every lower degree of life until they should come to the state of tranquility and peace, the rest that had been prepared for them. When they perceived that this higher operation had separated itself from their immediate state while they themselves still remained below and had not yet been elevated, then those outward powers of action fell into grief. After that lamentation, they turned their intention toward all the higher states that were still hidden from them, and they became of one understanding and purpose: that they would be lifted into higher states, and advance beyond all lower things, until the time appointed for their full elevation at the close of the ages.

The fourth grief will occur at the last judgment, when the final collective form of what had been gathered and held for elevation is taken up into separation from the lower. Then there will be lamentation on account of those who have confirmed falsity and profaned truth, because they can no longer receive restoration, since the operative powers by which conjunction could have been effected have been torn away from the influence of falsity. And those same souls, when the gathered collective is elevated and they are left alone, will lament because they remain behind in distress forever. For they are cut off and separated from that final collective, and it is necessary that those who have made themselves ready for ruin be taken into their recompense according to their deeds. They enter into falsity and are held in it, because they desired it and loved it, and placed their inmost delight and confidence within it. At the moment of the final elevation, they lament; and then their lamentation becomes vehement, because they are severed from the fellowship of that great collective form. They remain behind forever. This lamentation is dreadful, taking place openly before those who are fixed for ruin according to their works, and it does not cease, because they will not attain rest from that time onward.

For these external truths are also the outward investments of the fundamental falsities and evils in the ultimate degree, and this last lamentation rends them more than the three earlier griefs. It is far worse than the former states, because this final lamentation is not for their own elevation, but for those souls who are cut off from peace; for no state of rest can come to them, to relieve them from torment to eternity.

fills.notes: Context requires the upward withdrawal of the First Man from the lower mixture; the verb must express elevation out of the deep.
The correspondential ‘ultimate obscurity’ is expressed in this layer as the abyss of Darkness, i.e., the deep of mixture.
Stripping here is the removal of the outward investment, leaving the operative powers below in the ultimate plane.

Spiritual sense: they could do nothing but endure; their willing was turned toward permitted suffering for the sake of the whole work. In the oldest register this is expressed as ‘to subject their heart’ to affliction (submission under necessity), not moral exhortation.

The trajectory demanded is: soar to the heights, pass beyond all things, until the appointed consummation when they are taken up (the completion of elevation, matching the later ‘Statue taken up’ in ¶6). This keeps the impersonal cosmological register.
Spiritual sense: they cannot receive restoration. In this layer it is stated as the impossibility of ‘help’ or ‘profit’ being given once separation is fixed.

The severing of limbs corresponds to the tearing away of operative means of conjunction; what they are severed from is the binding-structures that held them in mixture. ‘Bonds’ preserves the cosmological-structural idiom.

The dreadful weeping is described as occurring ‘in front of’ those fixed for loss. In the oldest substrate this is regularly framed as occurring before the cosmic powers that administer separation, i.e., the rulers of the realm (not ecclesial spectators).
Pairs naturally with ‘rulers’ as the administering agencies of the lower realm; keeps the impersonal cosmological diction and matches the public, manifest character of the separation.

assessment: Most gaps are trivial restorations of fixed letters or already-constrained phrases. The substantial restorations were ¶4 (the clause of endurance under necessity), ¶5 (the appointed completion as a taking-up), and ¶6 (the impossibility of restoration, the severing from binding-structures, and the public character of the final lamentation before the administering cosmic powers). These were constrained primarily by the correspondential sequence: withdrawal, remaining below under burden, promised elevation, and final separation at the taking-up of the collective form.
